brand.name: 光桌
brand.tagline: 专业创作者的 AI 生图与精修工作台
brand.sector: AI 视觉生成与精修桌面工作台

sentence.zh: 队列中 12 组 4096×4096 批次已完成渲染，双栏像素级比对与局部重绘就绪。
sentence.en: Batch 048 rendered in 3.2s at 4096px — compare 4 seeds side by side and inpaint.

set.name: 批次矩阵 · Batch Matrix
set.mechanism: 模块化硬件控台：2×2 算力批次矩阵（三格排队实心块、一格精修视窗框）、工业窄体字标与高醒目度工业信号朱红。
set.expression_move: 2×2 队列矩阵右上角唯一镂空并点亮为工业信号红的精修输出格。
set.differs_by: 彻底摒弃圆角与渐变，用直棱直角的工业窄体汉字（WDXL Lubrifont SC）和森林绿+工业信号红的硬件控台配色，将 AI 生图工具定义为高吞吐率的桌面生产设备。

logo.concept: 2×2 批次生成网格：三枚实心模块代表排队生成的候选帧，右上角镂空取景模块代表被选中进入精修的定稿帧。
logo.defect: 右上角精修框内孔（14×14）在 16px 单色下偏小，且 accent 角色被映射为暗调 UI 色 #c21806；将内孔扩大至 18×18 提升小尺寸识别度，并改用 brand-2 保持纯正信号朱红。
ideas: 2×2 批次矩阵：三枚实心队列块配一枚右上角镂空精修视窗，直观对应「排队生成 4 张 → 挑 1 张精修」的黄金工作流。
等宽算力槽：三道垂直粗柱与一枚横向滑块咬合，如同硬件调音台的推子。
直角裁切框：左上与右下两枚 L 型重金属角铁合围出正方形画布。
像素阶梯块：由大到小三级正方形沿对角线咬合，代表从粗略草图到高分辨率精修的采样迭代。

rationale.claim: WDXL Lubrifont SC 具备 1.0 等线对比度与紧凑几何骨架，作为标题与字标展现出强烈的工业铭牌特征。
2×2 矩阵的单元边长 38、间距 12、镂空内孔 18×18，在 16px 极小尺寸下仍能保持清晰的物理间隙。

findings.message: light: link #163b2b on text #181d1a is 1.38:1, below 3.0:1 (links distinguishable from body text without underline (WCAG G183); WCAG 2, no rounding)
light: link and text collapse to CIEDE2000 7.9 for deutanopia (#35332c vs #1c1c1a)

suggested_fix.how: never carry meaning by colour alone (icon/label); or darken by OKLCH L -0.04, same hue

findings.message: #d92b18 is a mid-lightness trap: white 4.87:1, black 4.31:1; body text on it needs a darker or lighter derivative

suggested_fix.how: keep the brand colour for large areas/logo; put text on a derivative step of its scale

findings.message: light: border #cfd4cf on background #f2f4f2 is 1.36:1, below 3.0:1 (borders: dividers are exempt, input outlines need 3:1; WCAG 2, no rounding)

suggested_fix.how: darken by OKLCH L -0.22, same hue

findings.message: dark: border #3c4340 on background #101613 is 1.81:1, below 3.0:1 (borders: dividers are exempt, input outlines need 3:1; WCAG 2, no rounding)
#d92b18 sits at the sRGB gamut edge (93% of max chroma); vivid colours like this often fall outside CMYK process gamut: specify Lab D50 + tolerance, check with the printer, consider a spot colour
Ou-Luo two-colour model scores #163b2b + #d92b18 at -0.73 (negative = less harmonious on a grey CRT test, no context): model signal only; the pairing table in references/pairing.md takes precedence

findings.suggested_fix: fine if the brand never writes them (loanwords, names); else another family
